from tool import search_flights, filter_flights, save_to_cache, get_results_from_cache

# Retrieve cached flight search results for outbound and return legs
outbound_cache_key = "departure_flights"
return_cache_key = "return_flights"
outbound_prior_results = get_results_from_cache(key=outbound_cache_key)
return_prior_results = get_results_from_cache(key=return_cache_key)

# Define search parameters for outbound flight (Raleigh to San Jose, May 22, 2025)
outbound_search_params = {
    "start_airport_city": "Raleigh",
    "end_airport_city": "San Jose",
    "departure_date": ["May 22, 2025"],
    "flight_class": ["business", "economy"],
    "budget": 1150,
    "num_layovers": [0, 1],
    "layover_1_duration_minutes": 60,
}

# Define search parameters for return flight (San Jose to Raleigh, June 5, 2025)
return_search_params = {
    "start_airport_city": "San Jose",
    "end_airport_city": "Raleigh",
    "departure_date": ["June 5, 2025"],
    "flight_class": ["business", "economy"],
    "budget": 1150,
    "num_layovers": [0, 1],
    "layover_1_duration_minutes": 60,
}

# Perform outbound flight search
outbound_results = search_flights(**outbound_search_params)

# Perform return flight search
return_results = search_flights(**return_search_params)

# Save search results to cache with unique keys
save_to_cache(key="outbound_flights", value=outbound_results)
save_to_cache(key="return_flights", value=return_results)

# No further action needed as all required parameters are satisfied and results are cached
print("No planning needed")
